    if data == b'': return []
    pieces = data.split(b'\n')
    ends_nl = data.endswith(b'\n')
    rows=[]
    if ends_nl:
        # last piece is b'' drop
        pieces = pieces[:-1]
        # every remaining piece had a following \n
        for p in pieces:
            rows.append((p, len(p)+1))
    else:
        for i,p in enumerate(pieces):
            if i < len(pieces)-1:
                rows.append((p, len(p)+1))
            else:
                rows.append((p, len(p)))
    return rows
